facts.fact: The Scientific Reports conference proceedings from 2012 include articles such as "Diamond photonic crystal slab: Leaky modes and modified photoluminescence emission of surface-deposited quantum dots".
Another conference proceeding titled "Efficient light coupling for optically excited high-density metallic nanotip arrays" was also published in 2012.
The ISSN for Scientific Reports is 2045-2322 (online).
The conference proceedings can be accessed in an open-access format as of December 3, 2012.

result.summary: In 2012, Scientific Reports published several conference proceedings, including studies on photonic crystal slabs and metallic nanotip arrays, available for open access.
